### 🔧 What is this?

An **extended & fixed** version of the original [**U.R.A.I**](https://modrinth.com/mod/urai) mod by [@l33tfox](https://modrinth.com/user/L33tfox). This mod ships with an embedded, patched version of the original built right in.

> ⚠️ _The mod is completely safe. The fix was vibecoded, but it was just encoding stuff — nothing else was touched or has any security concerns._
